new_claim.statement: For arbitrary independent cap-one X,Y,Z and any symmetric 3x3 A with all three eigenvalue magnitudes >=1 and at least one zero physical diagonal entry, ||p_(X^TAX)||_infinity <= sqrt(2)[2+log(sqrt(2)+1/3)] = 3.617859563383761... < 3sqrt(2). Arbitrary affine terms cost nothing. Scaling gives C0/s for a three-coordinate block with spectral floor s.
new_claim.mechanism: Align the two physical hub edges by an orthogonal integration change in the two nonpivot coordinates without asserting independence; retain the joint cap and a sqrt(2) marginal cap. Root-integrate the original independent zero-pivot coordinate, combine a marginal-mass bound with a parabola-preimage bound, optimize by exact one-dimensional water filling, then pay L>=1 and |kappa|>=L^-2 directly from the target spectrum.

required_source_applied.application: Apply to -A_triangle with (+,+,-) magnitudes (1,1,2): p_(-Q)(s)<=2pi/sqrt(3)=3.627598728...<3sqrt(2) for s>=0.

partner_result_applied.application: Its centered-Gaussian strict determinant-slack theorem at v0=1/12,s=1,delta=1 gives the exact comparator peak 2sqrt(3)=3.464101615...<3sqrt(2) for -A_triangle. Comparator scope only; no Gaussian physical-input assumption.

unresolved_implication.statement: Within three physical coordinates, attack a generic target-valid all-nonzero-diagonal matrix, especially a near-zero but nonzero pivot with unequal hub edges and independent transverse curvature where no original-coordinate leaf is affine. Higher-dimensional multiscale/shared-row and extra-active-spectrum mechanisms also remain open.
